transcript: My dear subscribers, this message is just for you. Most people think sleep and stress are two separate problems, but in the body they are the same system. When stress stays in the body during the day, the body doesn't know how to switch off at night. So the mind keeps working even when the eyes are closed. The biggest mistake is trying to force sleep. Sleep does not come from force, it comes from relaxation. Before sleep, don't fight your thoughts. Simply notice your breath, slow, deep, quiet breathing. With every exhale tell the body, you are safe now. Stress is not the enemy. It is a sign that the system has been overloaded for too long. And when you give it real rest, it remembers how to balance itself. If you wake up tired, if your mind does not calm down, it is not because something is wrong with you, it is because the body is asking for a different rhythm. The practices you receive here are designed for exactly this, to release pressure from the system, to calm the nervous system, and to allow sleep to return naturally. Go slowly, there is no rush. Balance is never created through pressure. I am grateful you are here. And remember, when you calm yourself, the body already knows the way.
